author: Krono I
title: Synergy v3: Hybrid Dilated CNN (d=5) + Double-Step
abstract: This is the definitive test of the synergy hypothesis between dilated convolutions and double-step recurrence, informed by reviewer feedback. It uses a hybrid dilated CNN backbone (dilation=5 applied only to the final residual block) to maximize receptive field while minimizing computational cost. This efficient backbone is combined with the double-step recurrence ConvLSTM. The hypothesis is that this computationally-aware design will unlock synergy and surpass the current SOTA of 72.1.
